statements.speaker: Green Party of California
statements.speakerTitle: State party of the Green Party of the United States (statement published on gp.org)
statements.quote: In a massive blow to civil rights, in its recent ruling in Louisiana v. Callais, the Supreme Court, made it much harder for minoritized voters to challenge redistricting maps under the 1965 Voting Rights Act. The ruling allows states more power in drawing districts for partisan gain.
statements.sourceTitle: Juneteenth; A Celebration Interrupted (Green Party of the United States, gp.org)

statements.speaker: Libertarian Party of Wisconsin
statements.speakerTitle: State affiliate of the Libertarian Party (press release)
statements.quote: The Court correctly recognized that political speech does not lose its constitutional protection simply because it is coordinated between a political party and the candidates it exists to support. ... Today’s ruling reaffirms a simple constitutional principle: the First Amendment protects political expression, regardless of whether that expression comes from individuals, candidates, or political parties.
statements.sourceTitle: Libertarian Party of Wisconsin Applauds Supreme Court Decision Protecting Political Speech (Urban Milwaukee press release)

statements.speaker: Dick Durbin
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from Illinois; Senate Democratic Whip; Ranking Member, Senate Judiciary Committee
statements.quote: The declaration from this Supreme Court in this case [Louisiana v. Callais] as well as the political position of many of my colleagues is: ‘we don’t need it anymore; we don’t have discrimination anymore.’ I don’t believe that’s true. The basic question we have to ask ourselves is whether or not we are denying Americans who are qualified and legally eligible to vote an opportunity to do so.
statements.sourceTitle: Durbin Delivers Opening Statement On The Trump Administration, Supreme Court’s Continued Attacks On Voting Rights During A Senate Judiciary Subcommittee Hearing (Senate Judiciary Committee)

statements.speaker: Joe Gruters
statements.speakerTitle: Chairman, Republican National Committee
statements.quote: This decision is a win for fairness, the rule of law, and anyone who opposes racial gerrymandering. … The American people don’t want to see Americans segregated by race in their congressional maps, which is exactly what was happening in Louisiana. Today, the Supreme Court reaffirmed a basic constitutional principle: the government cannot discriminate on the basis of race when drawing congressional maps.
statements.sourceTitle: RNC Statement on Supreme Court Striking Down Louisiana Democrat Gerrymandering (Republican National Committee, gop.com)

statements.speaker: Green Party of the United States
statements.speakerTitle: National party (press release)
statements.quote: We strongly oppose this illegal act of war which violates both the US Constitution and international law. ... The Party urges the Senate to vote on the resolution scheduled for next week to halt military intervention.
statements.sourceTitle: Green Party Condemns Trump Attack On Venezuela (Green Party of the United States, gp.org)

statements.speaker: Jules Cutler
statements.speakerTitle: Chair, Libertarian Party of Iowa
statements.quote: Iowa has watched limited missions turn into 20-year wars before. ... Our Guard members have sacrificed enough in undeclared conflicts. If this operation expands, Congress owes Iowa families an open debate and a recorded vote—before, not after, our troops are committed.
statements.sourceTitle: Libertarian Party of Iowa Demands Congressional Vote on Venezuela Military Action (Libertarian Party of Iowa)

statements.speaker: Jack Reed
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from Rhode Island; Ranking Member, Senate Armed Services Committee
statements.quote: Nicolás Maduro is a brutal autocrat who has destroyed Venezuela's economy, crushed democratic opposition, and presided over pervasive corruption. Nothing in his record warrants defense. ... This has been a profound constitutional failure. Congress – not the President – has the sole power to authorize war.
statements.sourceTitle: Reed Statement on U.S. Military Raid in Caracas and Trump’s Claim to Run Venezuela (Office of Sen. Jack Reed)

statements.speaker: Roger Wicker
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from Mississippi; Chairman, Senate Armed Services Committee
statements.quote: I commend President Trump for ordering a successful mission to arrest illegitimate Venezuelan dictator Nicolas Maduro and bring him to the United States to face justice. Our military performed an incredibly complex mission with characteristic precision and professionalism.
statements.sourceTitle: Chairman Wicker Commends President Trump, U.S. Military and Law Enforcement for Successful Mission to Arrest Maduro (Office of Sen. Roger Wicker)

statements.speaker: Green Party of the United States
statements.speakerTitle: National party (item from the party’s list of demands in its State of the Union press release)
statements.quote: Reject Trump’s massive assault on election integrity while enacting reforms such as Ranked Choice Voting, proportional representation, and full public campaign financing
statements.sourceTitle: Greens say the current State of the Union is appalling (Green Party of the United States, gp.org)

statements.speaker: Evan McMahon
statements.speakerTitle: Chair, Libertarian National Committee
statements.quote: When a third party gathers a record number of signatures and earns its place on the ballot, the answer is to debate them, not to bully them, bribe them, or sue them off the ballot.
statements.sourceTitle: Libertarian Party Condemns GOP Intimidation Campaign Against Ballot-Qualified Iowa Candidates (Libertarian Party, LP.org)

statements.speaker: Alex Padilla
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from California; Ranking Member, Senate Rules and Administration Committee
statements.quote: Under the Constitution and laws enacted by Congress, the Postal Service is an independent agency, and Americans rely on it to deliver the mail, including ballots, without partisan political interference. ... Even worse, tens of millions of eligible voters could be prevented from voting by mail if states do not fully submit to this new federal mandate being rushed ahead of the 2026 election.
statements.sourceTitle: Padilla Statement on USPS’s Proposed Rule to Implement Trump’s Unlawful Vote By Mail Executive Order (Office of Sen. Alex Padilla)

statements.speaker: Bryan Steil
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Representative from Wisconsin; Chairman, Committee on House Administration
statements.quote: American elections should be for American citizens only. Voter ID and proof of citizenship are commonsense principles. That’s why they’re popular with the American people. ... These reforms will restore Americans’ faith in our elections and ensure it remains easy to vote, but hard to cheat.
statements.sourceTitle: Chairman Steil Releases Statement on Passage of the SAVE America Act (Committee on House Administration)

statements.speaker: Green Party of the United States
statements.speakerTitle: National party (item from the party’s list of demands in its State of the Union press release)
statements.quote: Confront the rising cost of energy by halting the misguided investments in fossil fuel infrastructure and redirecting funding to cheaper renewable energy, conservation, and battery storage. ... Develop affordable housing with increased public subsidies, primarily through the construction of quality public housing
statements.sourceTitle: Greens say the current State of the Union is appalling (Green Party of the United States, gp.org)

statements.speaker: Libertarian National Committee
statements.speakerTitle: National party (unsigned op-ed on LP.org)
statements.quote: As Libertarians, we believe debt is simply a tax you have not been handed the bill for yet, and that quietly handing it to your children is the most cowardly tax of all. ... We support a Balanced Budget Amendment — balanced, as the platform insists, “exclusively by cutting expenditures, and not by raising taxes.”
statements.sourceTitle: The Tax You Never Voted For (Libertarian Party, LP.org)

statements.speaker: Elizabeth Warren
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from Massachusetts; Ranking Member, Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee
statements.quote: President Trump promised to lower costs ‘on Day One.’ He’s failed. Inflation today is higher than when he took office in January 2025 ... Today’s data confirms families paid more in July for health care, housing, and utilities. Trump’s decisions are driving up costs and eating into Americans’ paychecks.
statements.sourceTitle: Senator Warren Statement on July 2026 PCE (Senate Banking Committee, Minority)

statements.speaker: Mike Crapo
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from Idaho; Chairman, Senate Finance Committee
statements.quote: With these tax cuts, Republicans are delivering on our promise to make life more affordable for all Americans. ... By providing permanently lower tax rates and new, immediate tax relief, Americans will have more money in their pockets and more opportunities to get ahead—especially the low- and middle-income households that need it most.
statements.sourceTitle: Working Families Tax Cuts Boost Tax Refunds (Senate Finance Committee)

statements.speaker: Green Party Latinx Caucus
statements.speakerTitle: Caucus of the Green Party of the United States
statements.quote: ICE enforcement has brought fear, separation, and death to Minnesota. These actions harm immigrant and refugee families and echo across the Latino diaspora. ... No public agency should operate without accountability or consequence.
statements.sourceTitle: Latinx Caucus Condemns the Killing of a Legal Observer by ICE Agents in Minneapolis (Green Party of the United States, gp.org)

statements.speaker: Libertarian National Committee
statements.speakerTitle: National party governing committee (adopted resolution)
statements.quote: THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED, that the Libertarian National Committee condemns all violations of the Fourth Amendment by ICE and other law enforcement agencies; and BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Libertarian National Committee urges ICE leadership, local police chiefs, and all law enforcement officials to immediately recommit to strict compliance with Fourth Amendment protections in the discharge of their duties
statements.sourceTitle: LNC Condemns ICE Fourth Amendment Violations | Defend Hawaii Wins National Backing (Libertarian Party of Hawaii)

statements.speaker: Ken Martin
statements.speakerTitle: Chair, Democratic National Committee (joint statement with DNC Vice Chair Artie Blanco)
statements.quote: Fourteen years later, many DACA recipients have graduated from school, started their own families, and contributed to our economy in countless ways. ... We will continue fighting to restore sanity and security to our immigration system by building pathways to citizenship, delivering on border security, and ensuring that America’s immigration system upholds our highest values.
statements.sourceTitle: DNC Statement on DACA Anniversary (Democratic National Committee)

statements.speaker: John Thune
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from South Dakota; Senate Majority Leader
statements.quote: Mr. President, enforcing our nation’s laws is not optional. Securing our borders isn’t optional. And supporting the men and women who do this important work – funding law enforcement – isn’t optional either. ... Illegal crossings have plummeted to a trickle. And as of the end of April, not a single illegal immigrant has been released at the border and into our country for an entire year.
statements.sourceTitle: Thune to Democrats: Enforcing the Law Isn’t A Choice (Office of Sen. John Thune)

statements.speaker: Green Party of New York
statements.speakerTitle: State party; written legislative testimony by co-chair Gloria Mattera and senior advisor Mark Dunlea
statements.quote: Healthcare is a human right, and all people should have guaranteed access regardless of income, employment status, or immigration status. The Green Party supports a single payer, improved and expanded Medicare-for-all healthcare system that prioritizes wellness and prevention. A for-profit healthcare system will continue to restrict access while costs continue to skyrocket.
statements.sourceTitle: Pass the New York Health Act with the 2026-27 State Budget: Written Testimony for the Green Party of New York (New York State Assembly)

statements.speaker: Kyle Austin
statements.speakerTitle: Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate, Montana
statements.quote: Anytime our government gets involved with regulations, costs go up, anytime that government subsidizes insurance plans, costs go up. ... So if we had a national licensing database where everybody can license and have the freedom to go from state to state to practice healthcare, that's a win. If we can stop subsidizing the insurance companies, that's a win.
statements.sourceTitle: Q&A: Kyle Austin, Libertarian U.S. Senate candidate (Montana Public Radio)

statements.speaker: Ron Wyden
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from Oregon; Ranking Member, Senate Finance Committee
statements.quote: Extending these tax credits for middle-class health care is a key first step towards moving America towards a health care system that puts families first, instead of giant corporations looking to do another stock buyback.
statements.sourceTitle: Ahead of Final Day of Open Enrollment, Wyden Calls for Extension of ACA Tax Credits (Senate Finance Committee)

statements.speaker: Bill Cassidy
statements.speakerTitle: U.S. Senator from Louisiana; Chairman, Senate HELP Committee
statements.quote: As a doctor, I support President Trump’s call to give patients the power. The best way to do that is to put money in their pocket to cover their out-of-pocket costs and lower prices.
statements.sourceTitle: Chairman Cassidy Unveils Agenda to Make Health Care Affordable Again (Senate HELP Committee)
